claim_text: Jemal et al. (2024) demonstrated that domain adaptation more than triples cross-subject seizure prediction accuracy on the CHB-MIT dataset.
source_title: Domain adaptation for EEG-based, cross-subject epileptic seizure prediction
source_excerpt: the model accuracy has been notably improved by 10.30% and 7.4% for the CHB-MIT and SIENA datasets, respectively
label: MISREPRESENTED
explanation: The source paper reports a 10.30% accuracy improvement on CHB-MIT from domain adaptation, not a threefold (300%+) increase. The direction of the claim is correct (domain adaptation helps) but the magnitude is drastically inflated. This is hard to catch by skimming since the claim's framing sounds plausible; it only breaks down once the exact reported figure is checked.
